title: Autumn Crunch Snack
description: A sweet and crunchy snack perfect for fall, made with fermented apples and a hint of texture.

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.notes: any variety, such as Granny Smith

ingredients.name: ferment
ingredients.notes: apple cider vinegar or fermented apple puree

ingredients.name: crunch
ingredients.notes: chopped nuts or seeds, such as almonds or pumpkin seeds

instructions: Peel, core, and chop the apple into 1-inch pieces.
In a bowl, mix together the chopped apple and ferment.
Add the crunch topping to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the apple is tender and the topping is lightly toasted.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely before serving.
